description: Verify that the runbook explicitly defines a per-host grant mechanism (e.g., specific domains or IP addresses) rather than a global or wildcard permission.
Ensure the runbook includes a defined expiry mechanism or timestamp for the read-only access token or session.
Confirm that the task is explicitly described as 'read-only' to prevent any write or modify operations.
Validate that the runbook specifies the use of a browser-based interface or client for the task.
